description: This file defines a custom matcher 'toHaveURL' for testing with Playwright, which waits for a page to have a specific URL or match a predicate, including handling case insensitivity and timeouts.

methods.name: toHaveURLWithPredicate
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for a Playwright page to match a URL predicate, with optional case insensitivity and timeout.

methods.name: toHaveURLMessage
methods.description: Generates a detailed message for the 'toHaveURL' matcher, indicating expected vs received URL, including diffs and formatting.
